title: K. al-Mafāḥiṣ ('Book of Inquiries')
transliterated_title: Kitāb al-Mafāḥiṣ (var. al-Mafāḥiṣ min al-ʿUlūm al-Ilāhiyya)

date.basis: MK: 'completed' 1 Shaʿbān 823/11 Aug 1420 (MS Landberg 146) or 19 Dhū l-Ḥijja 823/25 Dec 1420 (MS Majlis 10196), revised and expanded in 828/1425; a marginal correction to the Majlis autograph colophon says its date refers to copying (taswīd) only. Year fixed, day contested. Tension: a Sharḥ al-Tāʾiyya of presumably before 806/1404 (?) also refers to it. | AUDIT A1: a marginal correction says the Majlis colophon date refers to copying only, so the date is not stated as composition.

occasion: No addressee is stated; Sayyid Ḥusayn Akhlāṭī is named as the main oral source. Revised and expanded in 828/1425, with an audition note in the presence of Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī and companions (MS Landberg 146).
manuscript: 25 items listed; earliest: MS Majlis 10196/2 ff. 52-118 (823/1420, autograph sections); MS Landberg 146 (823/1420 (?), audition note 828/1425); MS Damghan 155 (7 Rajab 825/1422); Kılıç Ali Paşa 626 (833/1430); then copies from 853/1449 on.
summary: The magnum opus: a summa of lettrist theory on numerology, the science of letters and language symbology, deriving multiplicity from the One; it contains the Ṭahawī Circle and the jadāwil al-baḥr.
